mcp_items.name: io.github.DollhouseMCP/mcp-server
mcp_items.description:
Open source, platform agnostic, AI customization tools. Create your own customization elements to modify any AI to behave how you want it too.

- **Personas**: Define how your AI behaves - from creative writer to technical analyst
- **Skills**: Give your AI new capabilities like code review, research, or data analysis
- **Templates**: Get consistent, repeatable outputs for reports, docs, and more
- **Agents**: Automate complex tasks with goal-oriented AI decision makers
- **Memories**: Share persistent context across sessions and between different AI's

You can also use and modify elements from the community, and every element you create can be saved locally to your portfolio, in your personal GitHub portfolio, and can be shared back to the public DollhouseMCP Collection.

Key Features:
- 5 Element Types: Personas, Skills, Templates, Agents, and Memories
- Use any elements in any combination on any AI platform, and share them in real time.
- Use memories to share session information across multiple LLMs simultaneously
- 38 Professional Tools for complete element creation and management
- Community Collection of tested, ready-to-use elements
- Security-First Validation against hundreds of attack vectors
- Hot-Swap Elements without restarting
- Personal Portfolio system with GitHub integration
